plain_description.what: Engineering work to safely switch embedding models in the pipeline: explicit cache-file flags that fail closed, a check that the cache matches the model name, and a cosine-similarity guard (at least 0.99) before any other embedder is used. The default model's path must stay byte-for-byte unchanged.
plain_description.why: It is needed before any test can compare embedders (invariance) without silently reading the wrong embeddings.
plain_description.information: Working guards make later cross-embedder results trustworthy. Missing guards could mix up embeddings. Result: built, not finished as a test. Code is merged, one guard check passed (minimum cosine 0.9996), and the embedding caches for the other models were written. This says nothing yet about any embedder result.
